description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a front-end application using LightningJS framework. It includes layout templates, manages state for destinations, handles data fetching with stub fallback, and references various other components such as NavBar, Hero, DestinationList, and Loader.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home page, including layout and data loading logic.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: An async hook that initializes stub data, updates loading state, fetches real destinations, and handles errors.
